INFORMATION RECEIVED VIA WEB REPORT: THE BOAT "TOLLY HO" (26 FOOT TOLLY CRAFT) SANK AT APPROXIMATELY 5:00 A.M. ON THE ROCKS AT HOUSE BAY. SALVAGE BEGAN AT 6:00 A.M. AND THE BOAT WITH ADDITIONAL FLOATATION MOVED TO SHORE TO AWAIT LOW TIDE FOR SALVAGE. AT 4:00 A.M. ON 8/6/06 LOW TIDE WAS REACHED AND SALVAGE AND WATER REMOVAL FROM THE BOAT BEGAN. AT 12:00 P.M. THERE WAS NO HULL BREACH ONLY WATER ACROSS THE REAR OF THE BOAT WHICH CAUSED IT TO SWAMP AND SINK UP TO THE FLY DECK. IT WAS THE LOWEST AND HIGHEST TIDES OF THE MONTH WITH NO MOON. THE TIDE ACTION IN HOOD BAY IS EXTREME AND ALL GASOLINE LOST WOULD HAVE MOVED QUICKLY AND BEEN DISPERSED.
